topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I've noticed things about Mr. Henderson lately, things that don't add up. His car is always super clean, like the kind you see in magazines. The other day, I saw a gardener, not just any gardener, but one of those fancy ones who prunes each leaf to perfection. It's not right, you see, because he's always seemed so ordinary, like us. But now, there are rumors. People say he has a vault, with who knows what inside. I keep thinking about what I should do, if I should act like I know, or pretend nothing has changed. Everything feels different now, and I can't shake this restlessness, this sense that something's off. I wish things could just be simple again.
